sentences.text: Sir Elton Hercules John , -LRB- born Reginald Kenneth Dwight ; 25 March 1947 -RRB- is an English singer , pianist , and composer .
He has worked with lyricist Bernie Taupin as his songwriting partner since 1967 ; they have collaborated on more than 30 albums to date .	Bernie Taupin	Bernie Taupin

In his five-decade career Elton John has sold more than 300million records , making him one of the best-selling music artists in the world .	best-selling music artists in the world	list of best-selling music artists	Elton John	Elton John (album)
He has more than fifty Top 40 hits , including seven consecutive No. 1 US albums , 58 Billboard Top 40 singles , 27 Top 10 , four No. 2 and nine No. 1 .	Top 40	Top 40	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)
For 31 consecutive years -LRB- 1970 -- 2000 -RRB- he had at least one song in the Billboard Hot 100 .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

His tribute single , re-penned in dedication to the late Princess Diana , `` Candle in the Wind 1997 '' sold over 33million copies worldwide and is the best-selling single in the history of the UK and US singles charts .	Princess Diana	Princess Diana	Candle in the Wind 1997	Candle in the Wind 1997
He has also composed music , produced records , and has occasionally acted in films .
John owned Watford Football Club from 1976 to 1987 , and 1997 to 2002 .	Watford Football Club	Watford Football Club
He is an honorary Life President of the club , and in 2014 had a stand named after him at the club 's home stadium .	home stadium	Vicarage Road
Raised in the Pinner area of London , John learned to play piano at an early age , and by 1962 had formed Bluesology .	Pinner	Pinner	Bluesology	Bluesology
John met his songwriting partner , Bernie Taupin , in 1967 , after they had both answered an advert for songwriters .	Bernie Taupin	Bernie Taupin

For two years they wrote songs for other artists , including Lulu , and John also worked as a session musician for artists such as the Hollies and the Scaffold .	Lulu	Lulu (singer)	the Hollies	the Hollies	the Scaffold	the Scaffold
In 1969 his debut album , Empty Sky , was released .	Empty Sky	Empty Sky
In 1970 a single , `` Your Song '' , from his second album , Elton John , reached the top ten in the UK and the US , his first hit single .	Your Song	Your Song	Elton John	Elton John (album)

After decades of commercial chart success , John has also achieved success in musical theatre , both in the West End and on Broadway , composing the music for The Lion King -LRB- film and musical -RRB- , Aida and Billy Elliot the Musical .	West End	West End theatre	Broadway	Broadway theatre	The Lion King	The Lion King (musical)	Aida	Aida (musical)	Billy Elliot the Musical	Billy Elliot the Musical

He has received five Grammy Awards , five Brit Awards -- winning two awards for Outstanding Contribution to Music and the first Brits Icon in 2013 for his `` lasting impact on British culture '' , an Academy Award , a Golden Globe Award , a Tony Award , a Disney Legends award , and the Kennedy Center Honors in 2004 . In 2004 , Rolling Stone ranked him Number 49 on its list of 100 influential musicians of the rock and roll era .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone

In 2013 , Billboard ranked him the most successful male solo artist on the Billboard Hot 100 Top All-Time Artists -LRB- third overall behind the Beatles and Madonna -RRB- .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	the Beatles	the Beatles	Madonna	Madonna (entertainer)

He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1994 , is an inductee into the Songwriters Hall of Fame , and is a fellow of the British Academy of Songwriters , Composers and Authors .	Rock	Rock music	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame

Having been named a Order of the British Empire in 1996 , John was made a Knight Bachelor by Elizabeth II for `` services to music and charitable services '' in 1998 .	Order of the British Empire	Order of the British Empire	Knight Bachelor	Knight Bachelor	Elizabeth II	Elizabeth II

John has performed at a number of royal events , such as the funeral of Princess Diana at Westminster Abbey in 1997 , the Party at the Palace in 2002 and the Queen 's Diamond Jubilee Concert outside Buckingham Palace in 2012 . He has been heavily involved in the fight against AIDS since the late 1980s .	AIDS	HIV/AIDS
